_comment: Source of truth for the `prod` GitHub Environment protection rules.
GitHub does not yet ingest this file on its own — apply it via the REST
API or a thin Terraform `github_repository_environment` resource (see
the `apply` snippet at the bottom of this file). Committing it here keeps
the rules code-reviewed under CODEOWNERS and audit-traceable for SOC 2.
and therefore inherits these rules + the env-scoped secrets listed below.
